subject: Proposed dotted-line consolidation and comms (confidential)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bennett <lauren_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed dotted-line consolidation and comms (confidential)

Hi all,

I want to surface a proposal for a small consolidation in the infra surface that I think will simplify the operating model and reduce duplicated ownership across the next 6–9 months. High level: move the Core Infra pod (3 ICs + 1 manager) into Compute Services as a dotted-line reporting change; primary day-to-day work and tech ownership would be with Compute Services, while career reporting and performance remains with their current manager for the next two quarters to allow a measured transition.

Why: we've seen repeated handoffs for runtime optimizations and kernel selection that add latency to delivery. Centralizing day-to-day work in Compute Services should reduce coordination overhead and speed up feature rollouts.

What I'm asking for now:
- Leadership OK to proceed with a confidential review (no all-hands communication yet).
- HR (Monica) to validate payroll/severance impact and timeline if any role reductions are needed.
- Compensation and Legal review to confirm there are no contractual blockers.
- Approve the attached org chart (org_chart_v3.pdf) and the tentative comms draft (comms_draft_role_changes.docx) for redaction and legal review.

Constraints and sensitivities:
- We should treat this as highly confidential until we have HR sign-off; please avoid copying non-essential folks.
- One senior IC in Core Infra has expressed concerns in 1:1s about scope overlap; we need a careful one-on-one transition plan if reporting changes impact compensation.

Timeline I'm proposing: decision to proceed by 2027-09-20 so HR can hit payroll and contracting windows; sync with Legal/Comp by 2027-09-17.

Next steps: can we do a 30-min sync today or tomorrow? I added a candidate slot in the related link.

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Director, Infrastructure Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: org_chart_v3.pdf (diagram), comms_draft_role_changes.docx (redacted messaging draft)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bennett <lauren_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed dotted-line consolidation and comms (confidential)

Kim — thanks for the clear write-up and the attachments. Quick thoughts inline: 

> move the Core Infra pod (3 ICs + 1 manager) into Compute Services as a dotted-line reporting change; primary day-to-day work and tech ownership would be with Compute Services

I agree with the rationale but would prefer the manager retain workload ownership for at least one more sprint cycle (4 weeks) to avoid disrupting current delivery commitments (we have a kernel rollout mid-Oct). Can we make that explicit in the transition timeline?

On the sensitivity point — we should anonymize the comms draft before sharing with any external adviser. That said, I think bringing Sarah from BrightEdge in to consult on change management for the impacted ICs would be useful for script development and 1:1 coaching (assuming Legal is comfortable).

Also tagging Lauren on the compensation angle: if there's any move that could materially affect comp bands we need an immediate run with Comp to size delta and a suggested uplift or retention.

I can join a quick sync today at 15:00 PT or tomorrow morning.

—Marissa

Team,

Thanks for looping HR in early and for keeping this confidential. From an HR/process standpoint here's what I need to run a safe, compliant transition: 

1) Final list of impacted headcount by role title (anonymized names are fine for the leadership discussion).
2) A job-impact statement per role (1–2 paragraphs) describing changes to day-to-day responsibilities and reporting.
3) Any suggested severance/retention framework or precedent you'd like us to apply.
4) Desired communication cadence (one-on-ones, manager script, all-IC FAQ) — the comms_draft looks like a good starting point but please remove names until Legal signs off.

Critical payroll note: payroll cutoff for role/comp changes is 2027-10-01. To ensure any changes (including payouts) are reflected on the Oct 15 cycle, leadership decisions and final HR inputs need to be received by 2027-09-20 COB. If we miss that window we push all impact into the Nov payroll run and that increases change anxiety.

I'm attaching an initial HR transition checklist (hr_transition_checklist.xlsx) I will use to track approvals and tasks. Once we have the anonymized list and impact statements I can scope severance ranges and required authorizations.

I can join the sync tomorrow at 09:30 PT. If Legal/Comp need extra time, please flag that explicitly so we can push the communication timeline accordingly.

Best,

Monica Patel
Senior People Partner, Talent & HR Ops
Redwood Inference

Action items I will take on today:
- Produce anonymized headcount list + 1–2 paragraph job-impact statements (will deliver by 2027-09-16 12:00 PT).
- Redact comms draft and circulate to Legal/Comp first; Marissa, can you take point on anonymization?
- Book a 30-min leadership touchpoint for 2027-09-17 10:00 PT (I shared the scheduler link above).

Monica — thanks for the payroll cutoff note; we'll treat 09-20 as the decision deadline for leadership approvals.

Marissa — happy to bring Sarah in once Legal confirms external adviser is allowed; Sarah, thanks for standing by (I added you to this thread so Monica and Legal can confirm).

I'll post the anonymized pack by tomorrow noon.

Kim
